findings.title: Section family not in the contract layout plan

evidence.snippet: family text-only is not in the plan (metric strip, dense data table, split detail pane, status queue, command palette)

findings.fix: Rebuild the section with a family from the plan, or amend the contract.
findings.why: The contract fixed the layout families: a section outside the plan means the build drifted from the ruling.
